methodology: Empirical decision threshold calibration based on Youden J-statistic maximization and F1-harmonic score balance on 2015-2024 frozen historical sequences

provenance.model_preservation: Frozen M11 LSTM forward-pass probabilities are strictly preserved without modification or scaling

tier_semantics.LOW: Normal vigilance; environmental indicators within normal non-event range
tier_semantics.MODERATE: Heightened monitoring; environmental conditions elevated above dry baseline
tier_semantics.HIGH: Calibrated decision threshold breached; actionable hazard alert
tier_semantics.CRITICAL: Extreme risk threshold breached; immediate evacuation / response advisory

Bagalkot.operational_notes: Well-behaved probability distribution (range 0.17 to 0.67). Calibrated threshold yields 78.3% sensitivity and 78.5% specificity.

Belagavi.operational_notes: Elevated probability baseline (min 0.4769, dry median 0.5276). Calibrated threshold cuts false alarms by 1,650 days (specificity rises from 1.3% to 61.2%), but feature discrimination remains challenging.

Kodagu.operational_notes: High monsoon baseline. Calibrated threshold separates heavy precipitation saturation from river basin flood peaks; false alarms drop from 2,478 to 540 days (specificity rises from 1.3% to 78.5%).

Uttara Kannada.operational_notes: Compressed lower probability bound (min prob 0.5115). Global 0.50 cutoff failed with 0% specificity (100% false alarm rate); calibrated 0.55 threshold restores 73.6% specificity.
